queries_run: BlackRock business model transition platform Aladdin technology services 2026
asset management disintermediation direct indexing D2C 2026 BlackRock
BlackRock go-to-market change private markets wealth retail 2026

findings.claim: BlackRock 2026 SEC 文件稱零售私募市場 AUM 已逾 300 億美元，並把私募進財富通路的產品擴展到更多產品與多元另類資產模型
findings.excerpt: It is now extending its private markets to wealth offering into a broader set of products and multi-alternatives models.

findings.claim: 2025 年科技服務與訂閱收入 20 億美元、年增 24%；ACV 年增 31%（不含 Preqin 為 16%）
findings.excerpt: technology services and subscription revenue of $2.0 billion was up 24% year-over-year. Annual contract value rose 31% year-over-year including ACV related to Preqin, and 16% excluding ACV related to Preqin

findings.claim: 2026 年 3 月 BlackRock 與 iCapital 結盟，將另類投資科技平台接入 Aladdin Wealth
Jio BlackRock（印度合資）2026-04-23 起開放共同基金經銷商，結束 2025-07 以來僅直銷的模式；屬合資公司層級變動，非 BlackRock 全球策略
findings.source: Cafemutual: Jio BlackRock MF starts distributor empanelment
findings.excerpt: After remaining a direct-plan-only fund house for over a year, Jio BlackRock has finally opened up its schemes to mutual fund distributors.

findings.claim: 直接指數化：BlackRock 經 Aperio 僅與第三方金融中介合作（非 D2C）；未找到 2026 年 BlackRock 去中介化的直接報導，來源為 2022 年資料
findings.source: Kitces / etf.com 搜尋結果（2022 年資料）

channel_business_model_shift.note: 未找到 2026 年 go-to-market 組織重整的報導；代幣化作為配銷通路僅有二手評論（onebullex），未採用。
